bio: Not far from the city centre, this spacious restaurant extends through contemporary settings organised over several spaces. The gastronomic offerings are eclectic and of high quality: a brasserie where you can enjoy excellent meat from different parts of the world, with special attention to the matured meats, flanked by a fair selection of tacos. The atmosphere is more relaxed at lunchtime, while in the evening the venue comes alive by becoming a trendy hangout, with two evenings dedicated to live music and DJ sets on weekends....
